description: Address GitHub issue #45. Make collection_id optional for google.drive.collection.changes.list so drive-wide watch channels can list changes, add regression tests, verify quality, and publish a PR.

comments.text: Implemented drive-wide collection change listing while keeping watch and poll collection IDs required. Focused tests: 60 passed. Full mix quality passed. Demo format, warnings-as-errors compile, and 21 tests passed.

title: Allow drive-wide Google Drive change listing
